nodes.speaker: Mayor
nodes.text: Welcome to the Plaza office! This is where community happens.

nodes.speaker: Mayor
text: Plaza is a community platform. A place to connect, share, and collaborate with others.
Think of it as the village's town hall, but online. Events, discussions, and shared spaces — all in one spot.

nodes.speaker: Mayor
nodes.text: The portal to Plaza is on the right. Open to everyone — community is for all.

nodes.speaker: Mayor
nodes.text: Have a look around. The bulletin boards have community updates. Portal's on the right whenever you're ready to jump in.

nodes.speaker: Mayor
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. See you in the plaza!
